> ❗️ Notes
>
> * You can schedule a message only within the campaign period.
> * Messages will not deliver between 9:00 pm to 9:00 am. Any message scheduled within this period will be sent post 9:00 am.
> * Promotional messages can only be sent between 10:00 AM and 9:00 PM IST. Any messages triggered outside this window will not be processed. It is recommended to complete all promotional campaigns by 8:00 PM IST to avoid delivery issues.

blocks.raw:
> 📘 Note
>
> The campaign starts sending only after the configured Start date and time. If the scheduled send time on the Start date is earlier than the configured Start time, that occurrence is skipped, and the first message is sent at the next scheduled occurrence. If the scheduled send time is on or after the configured Start time, the campaign is sent on the Start date.

blocks.raw: ## Message throttle settings
blocks.text: Message throttle settings

blocks.raw: The message throttle settings allow you to control the rate at which messages are sent to a large audience. For example, if the audience size is 4,000 members, you can send the emails first to 2,500 people, and then send the rest later.
blocks.text: The message throttle settings allow you to control the rate at which messages are sent to a large audience. For example, if the audience size is 4,000 members, you can send the emails first to 2,500 people, and then send the rest later.

blocks.raw: Key features:
blocks.text: Key features:

blocks.raw:
* Helps avoid delivery overloads and improves message performance.
* Controls the delivery timing and specifies the number of messages to be sent within a defined time period.

blocks.raw: You can enable **Execute message only after audience sync completion**when configuring the **<Anchor label="Repeat Periodically" target="_blank" href="https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/schedule-message#repeats-periodically">Repeat Periodically</Anchor>** scheduling option. This ensures that the campaign proceeds only after confirming EI sync completion and that the audience is up to date. This capability is feature gated and is not enabled by default. If the option is not visible, raise a request to the Product Support team (PST) to enable it.

blocks.text: To enable, perform the following:

blocks.raw:
1. After you define and schedule the recurring period (repeats periodically) for the campaign messages, select the check box **Execute message only after audience sync completion**.
2. If required, select the check box **Wait for Sync completion until** and define the time until which the system should wait for the audience sync. If the audience sync is not completed by this time, the recurring messages are sent without waiting for the audience sync. For instance, if you set this time as 9 pm, the system will wait until 9 pm for the sync to complete. If the sync is not completed by 9 pm, the campaign will execute regardless.
   The recurring messages are not sent if you do not define a sync cut-off time and the audience sync is not completed.

blocks.raw: ## Setting an alert for recurring messages
blocks.text: Setting an alert for recurring messages

blocks.raw: You can set alerts for recurring messages in the campaign settings. For information, refer to the [Recurring message expiry alert](https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/campaign-settings#recurring-message-expiry-alert).

blocks.text: For information on configuring a recurring campaign, refer to the Recurring Campaign documentation.

blocks.raw: ## Blackout time window
blocks.text: Blackout time window

blocks.raw: Custom blackout windows are essential for brands to enhance customer retention and increase marketing return on investment (ROI) by communicating at optimal times. Brands can configure their own custom blackout time windows during which no communications will be sent.
